value: Two homesteads near the Merrow road were recently struck by the Ashen Hand. The pirates have made a visible appearance, raiding structures along that trade route. In response, the Merrow Freeholds have changed their transport protocols, insisting that all caravans now travel in pairs. This, naturally, means a certain uptick in the cost of whatever they are hauling. The situation remains tense along the border zones. No other immediate developments have been noted from the other factions operating near Kettle Hollow.

The Ashen Hand are out in numbers. Two homesteads on the Merrow road lost their stores, and one lost its roof. Merrow traders are travelling in pairs now, which doubles the guards and, they assure me, the prices.

Grass fires in the south have the Kinn on the move. They are not, by their account, looking for trouble. Neither, I suspect, is trouble looking for them, but it usually finds someone.

attempts.text: Ashen Hand pirates struck again, raiding two homesteads situated near the Merrow road. In response to the persistent thievery, the Merrow Freeholds have mandated that all caravans now travel in pairs. This pairing, unsurprisingly, seems to be impacting local transport costs. Elsewhere, the movement of the Kinn of the Long Grass remains observable near the south, though no specific incidents have been publicly confirmed regarding their passage.
